answer: The walnut register is checked at draw time, delta lists the eligible set, and cipher seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 23 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 23 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 472 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
